title: Raised to a High Station
notes: Scholars differ on what “a high station” means: a high rank and honour, or being taken up to the heavens. In the hadith of the Night Journey (Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim), the Prophet met Idris in the fourth heaven.
art: The rising light is symbolic; Idris appears only as a small figure of light seen from far behind.
imagePrompt: A mountaintop at dawn above a sea of clouds, seen from far behind: ink-wash peaks below layered in blues and violets, the sky warming to pale gold; a single small figure of white-gold light alone at the summit; a soft column of light descending gently and surrounding him, his glow blending into it; the light rising through layered clouds that part like brush strokes; then an empty summit in full morning light, the clouds settling back; calm, quiet and dignified, no dramatic flashes, parchment texture, no faces.

beats.say: At dawn, Idris stood alone on a high summit above a sea of clouds.
A gentle light came down and surrounded him.
Then the summit stood empty in the morning light.

verse.en: And We raised him to a high station.
